Name: Elianna's Tactical Supply Pack
Desc: Elianna's tactical supply pack. Inside are 1 expired serum, half a roll of filthy bandages, a small storage device with starship floor plans, and an empty compressed biscuit wrapper. Valen's contact information and her name are written carefully on the wrapper. Elianna used the last of her strength to press the door-close button. She had no time to leave any final words.

The storage device was found below the communications tower. Someone must have dropped it there on purpose, using the tough fabric from an F.O.S. instructor uniform as a makeshift parachute. The device barely still works, and inside is a short video.

Name: Valen
Desc: Elianna, I'm sorry. I can't keep my promise. I couldn't save Al or Toby... Haha. Though I'll be seeing them soon enough. But we did it! We protected the communications tower!

Name: Valen
Desc: I do still regret one thing. I promised I'd take you to that restaurant in Babylonia... I don't even know how things are there now. I just hope it's still open when you make it back.

Name: Valen
Desc: Try that grilled fish for me, okay? It looked so good in the ad!

Name: Valen
Desc: Cough... All right. I think that's everything. My account password is your birthday. Use whatever money is left however you want. It's probably the last thing I can give you. So... I guess this is goodbye.
He leans closer to the camera. His face is streaked with blood, but his eyes are still gentle.

Name: Valen
Desc: Elianna, don't follow me too soon. Take your time. Go back to Babylonia and grow old happy. But let me be selfish just this once... please don't forget me.

Name: Valen
Desc: I'll be waiting for you at the end of the stars. That's where we'll meet again.

Name: Vanessa
Desc: According to Elianna's map, the warehouse should be right here...

Name: Construct Soldier A
Desc: Commandant Vanessa, I advise against going in. The Punishing Virus levels inside are extremely high...

Name: Vanessa
Desc: Then what am I supposed to do, use you as the heavy cannon? Find a way to open that door.

Name: Construct Soldier B
Desc: Y-yes...

Name: Construct Soldier A
Desc: Cover us! There are too many of them! Re-retreat!

Name: Vanessa
Desc: Retreat? Are you kidding me? Gather supplies! Take everything you can! Ugh...

Name: Construct Soldier B
Desc: Commandant Vanessa! You're hurt!

Name: Vanessa
Desc: Quit talking and move! Take everything you can carry! The heavy cannon, and that ammo crate too! Hurry!
Tactical supply packs are scattered across the ground. This one has a tiny cat badge pinned to it. Along with the standard supplies, there's also a broken handheld game console inside.
This tactical supply pack is soaked with blood. Inside is a small note torn from a notebook. It says:
No one cares when a mayfly dies. No one will care when I die either. Everything rises. Everything falls.
Another tactical pack has a hidden row of large-caliber rounds and some illegally modified gun parts. That's a serious violation of F.O.S. school rules!
But... where did their owners go?
Half a dusty cracker lies in the ruins. One side still bears the mark of someone gripping it tightly.
In a place this short on supplies, who could afford to throw away half a cracker?
A few dandelions sway in the institute's flowerbed. They're small and crooked, their leaves tinged with sickly yellow.
But they've stayed alive in the flowerbed, quietly watching it all.
Lucia's "Growth Record Box," filled with keepsakes from every stage of her childhood.
Her first drawing. Her first crayon, worn down to a stub. The report card from her first exam. The first scrapbook she ever made. And more...
A headset that was just placed inside, along with an admission letter from F.O.S. College.

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: REPORT: During a recent rotation training flight to the ground, the college's Airborne Command Post was hijacked midair. The attackers planned to crash it into Bifrost.

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: In more encouraging news, during the incident, two cadets on airborne duty worked with ground communications staff and several students to stop the armed hijackers' plan.

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: The injured survivors have been taken to F.O.S. College Hospital. The college and its partner insurers are providing the maximum compensation available to the crew members who lost their lives.

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: Bifrost and the damaged F.O.S. Training Grounds are currently under repair. Students who need to make reservations should use Training Grounds 8 through 11 instead...

Name: F.O.S. College Paper
Desc: Up next, another news report.
A notebook containing a handwritten copy of the F.O.S. Anthem, marked with edits, notes, and cross-outs.
As the flames spread in the distance, the pioneers' robes become stained with blood.
I bid farewell to yesterday's campus, armed with everything I have been taught.
Dreams took root in the Golden Age... The embers were rekindled in the Reconquista Age.
A road emerges from the ruins,
marked by the footsteps of all of those who went before us.
On the smoke-scorched, battle-damaged deck of F.O.S., someone wrote those words in blood.
"No one who lights a torch in the dark should ever be forgotten."

Name: F.O.S. Student
Desc: Can you... still get up?

Name: F.O.S. Student
Desc: If you can still stand... let's move.

Name: F.O.S. Student
Desc: We need to activate the beacon inside the F.O.S. Monument, and then...

Name: F.O.S. Student
Desc: Homeward.
A plump orange cat has slipped into the group.
It still hasn't gotten used to the roar of Alpha's motorcycle, and would rather rest whenever the group stops along the way.
Sometimes it naps lightly and cautiously. Other times it sprawls onto its back and sleeps without a care in the world.

As for the "companions" it has to live with, it dislikes the white cat, but as long as they keep their distance, things stay peaceful. The gray cat, though... it actually likes that one, and sometimes runs over just to bite its butt.
It doesn't really like the new cat food. Maybe because it isn't roasted like the old one, so it lacks that crispy smell and texture.
So now it's eating about three pounds less every day. At this rate, it should slim down soon.
